title: Counting repeated words
description: You can use words as dictionary keys and their frequencies as values.

steps.description: You visit duck, duck, goose and duck in order. counts starts empty before the loop.
The membership test selects between increasing an existing value and creating a new entry. The first duck starts at one.

steps.question: What happens when goose appears for the first time?
steps.answer: goose is absent from counts, so the else branch stores one for that key.

steps.description: You see {'duck': 3, 'goose': 1}. The repeated duck visits update one entry rather than creating duplicate keys.
